label_decoding_note: Source label was one-hot (N, 2); decoded via argmax(axis=1) to a flat 0/1 vector. Verified fraud_count and normal_count in the exported .mat match the frozen dataset_manifest.json exactly.
adapter_justification: T-Finance is natively a homogeneous graph. Collapsing to a single-relation view ('homo') preserves the exact transaction topology without architectural or label modifications.
relation1_relation2_relation3_note: T-Finance has a single relation. relation1/relation2/relation3 pickles are copies of the homo adjacency list, not distinct relations, since PC-GNN's load_data() hardcodes exactly 4 pickle loads per dataset with no path for fewer.
